speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pica (specifically Pagophagia or Geophagia) secondary to severe Iron Deficiency Anemia, likely exacerbated by nutritional deprivation during incarceration. Immediate blood work for hemoglobin, ferritin, and retinal imaging is required to confirm severity and guide supplementation.
